Migrate residual live prose uses of Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl.
Wire the vocabulary guard into the root Makefile lint target so the check runs in both local and CI contexts and fails on unallowlisted matches, count drift, malformed entries, or stale rows.

Define scoped bare-token matching rules: match bare SC or SCs only under src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md; exclude docs/archive/**, docs/experiments/**, vendor bundles, and O-RAN-SC sites.
Preserve exactly four permanent semantic carve-outs with pinned counts: T2 experiment language, definition-of-done concept entries, migration/lifecycle test probes, and captured Jira fixtures.
